Definition: Elon of Beth-chanan, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Elon of Beth-chanan is a place in Palestine. The name appears in 1 Kings (1 Kings 4:9). It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elon of Beth-chanan matters because God's story happened in real places, and Elon of Beth-chanan is one of them.
